---
title: "Step 2: ESTABLISHED / NON-ESTABLISHED variant tables"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
```

Read the Exomiser results, split them into ESTABLISHED genes (manually
confirmed KS gene / participant pairs) and NON-ESTABLISHED genes (all other
genes outside the KS gene list), and save one table per group. These tables
feed Figures 2B and 2C and step 6.

## Inputs

```{r inputs}
data_filter <- read_study_filter()
message("Participants passing study filtering: ", nrow(data_filter))

genes_john <- read_manual_genes(data_filter)

# KS gene list (one gene symbol per line, no header)
ks_genes <- read_lines(ks_genes_file)
message("KS genes: ", length(ks_genes))
```

## ESTABLISHED genes

Each run is first collapsed to its best-ranked row per gene / participant
(one rank per gene instead of one per inheritance mode); only then are
PAPSS2/FAM20C removed and the remaining genes re-ranked, within that run.

```{r read-run}
read_collapsed_run <- function(run) {
  read_exomiser_run(run) %>%
    best_rank_per_gene() %>%
    maybe_remove_genes()
}
```

Exomiser hits in the manually confirmed gene / participant pairs.

```{r established}
vars_established <- read_collapsed_run(my_run) %>%
  mutate(GROUP = "ESTABLISHED")

message("Participants (ESTABLISHED run): ", n_distinct(vars_established$Participant_ID))

vars_established <- vars_established %>%
  inner_join(genes_john, by = c("Participant_ID", "GENE_SYMBOL"), relationship = "many-to-many")
```

## NON-ESTABLISHED genes

Everything else in study participants, excluding known KS genes.

```{r nonestablished}
vars_nonestablished <- read_collapsed_run(nonhit_run) %>%
  mutate(GROUP = "NON-ESTABLISHED") %>%
  filter(Participant_ID %in% data_filter$VCF_FILE_ID,
         !GENE_SYMBOL %in% ks_genes)
```

## Combine, save

The final collapse only matters for a gene / participant pair present in both
groups: it keeps the better-ranked row.

```{r combine-save}
all_vars <- bind_rows(vars_established, vars_nonestablished) %>%
  best_rank_per_gene()

all_vars %>%
  count(GROUP, name = "gene_participant_pairs") %>%
  knitr::kable()

write_tsv(filter(all_vars, GROUP == "ESTABLISHED"), established_file)
write_tsv(filter(all_vars, GROUP == "NON-ESTABLISHED"), nonestablished_file)
```
